corrective_action: ASML Twinscan NXE wafer stage chuck recalibration followed by Metal-0/Via-0 resist strip and re-patterning on Reticle Field R4-C2.
telemetry_status: Verified post-rework KLA Archer 800 & electrical test export.
engineering_finding: Corrective stage recalibration and re-patterning lowered EUV lithography overlay error from 2.4 nm down to 0.68 nm, well within the 1.2 nm requirement. Electrical probe confirms zero interconnect bridge shorts and stable 95.3% dopant activation with no side-effect degradation.
